steps: Rinse quinoa under cold water, then combine with water in a saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a boil, cover and cook for 15 minutes until quinoa is fluffy and water is absorbed.
Trim and dice zucchini into 1 cm pieces; slice cooked carrot into thin rounds.
Warm olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then add ground turkey.
Cook turkey for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Add garlic, zucchini, carrot, oregano and crushed tomatoes to the skillet.
Simmer for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft.
Serve turkey mixture over quinoa. Mash or blend for babies under 9 months. Keeps refrigerated for 3 days.
